camel_example: aliyun sas ExecStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --ExecAction terminate --StrategyId 215421 --Lang zh
description_en: Performs a baseline check on machines within a specified policy
description_zh: 指定策略，对策略内的机器做检查项扫描
kebab_example: aliyun sas exec-strategy --lang zh --strategy-id 215421 --exec-action terminate --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecStrategy

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the baseline check policy.
You can call the [DescribeStrategy](~~DescribeStrategy~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
基线检查策略ID。
调用[DescribeStrategy](~~DescribeStrategy~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
The action to perform. Default value: exec. Valid values:

exec: exec.
terminate: stop
parameters.help_zh:
设置本次执行的动作，默认为exec。取值：

exec：执行。
terminate：终止
parameters.name: exec_action

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
